notes.title: Isomorph has been released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Isomorph has been released on the Steam store.

You can find the Steam page here:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/516870]http://store.steampowered.com/app/516870[/url]

The game website can be found here:
[url=http://playerbuce.com/isomorph]http://playerbuce.com/isomorph[/url]

The soundtrack can be found on Bandcamp here:
[url=https://playerbuce.bandcamp.com/album/isomorph]http://playerbuce.bandcamp.com/album/isomorph[/url]

notes.title: Isomorph Coming September 2nd, 2016
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Isomorph is almost complete. It will be coming out on Friday, September 2nd.

[h1]You can view the store page here:[/h1]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/516870]http://store.steampowered.com/app/516870[/url]

[h1]The game trailer is here:[/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sjRYy5_0QBQ]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sjRYy5_0QBQ[/url]

Thanks for your support.
